title: ID0394642-DC/Si-D/BE[fOfSrq] - DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA09-10
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA09-10 CMD: OFF & FBK:ON
Root cause:
Faulty contactor → if CMD = OFF and we still have FBK:ON that means that the measure still shows voltage as if the contactor is still closed and didn't open as it should
Solution:
Replaced contactor
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: ID0394642-DC/Si-D/BE[fOfSrq] - DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA09-10 CRM:00315002185
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / PD 170001323
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
fOfSrq
Problem Description
: Contactor CMD=Off during sessions making it abort
Troubleshooting
:
From what I see from the logs, we need to evaluate the situation, since we are not checking the feedback from the contactor's itself it might be that there is still voltage in QA09-10 read from the IMD.
In these logs you showed me, here is what happens:
They scan the RFID tag to stop the session and the contactor goes to CMD:OFF but FBK:ON because we might see some voltage being measured afterwards.
If this only happens after a P06_Charge → P07_Stop then it is fine since it's only showing from a timeout point of view, the voltage will decrease eventually. This can also be a problem with TF5 or the similar case where we found ~15V oscilating.
Unless I check via DebugStation I cannot confirm this but if it only happens at the end session there is no need to replace the contactor.
What is your opinion?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0394642
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

change
the

replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0394642-DC/Si-D/BE[fOfSrq] - DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA09-10 CRM:00315002185
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco
Thanks for the analysis, yes indeed I see only problems after ending charging sessions and not during sessions. What I see is that also during sessions we have converter grouping error caused by contactors 9&10 not functioning properly. It is indeed possible that we have the similar problem like a few weeks ago that the contactors are “leaking”. But then I expect that we also see this error even when there are no charging sessions.
I think we first need to check via the debug tool and monitor if we see any small voltages running. If not we need to replace 9&10 I think.
Br.

additional_info.subject: ID0394642-DC/Si-D/BE[fOfSrq] - DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA09-10 CRM:00315002185
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
I've checked the DebugStation in Idle because I wasn't able to get a charging session live. It's indeed hard to capture while having other tasks.
For me, it's clear that there is something wrong with the contact that is not responding to the CMD: OFF which means that it's stuck. For me you can proceed with the replacement, if the error still persists we need to re-evaluate the situation.
I will send this ticket to your queue.
Best regards,
Francisco
